verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not equity or cap-table management software, so a cap-table change audit log is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude maintains a cap table of record, and the SSO/provisioning and workspace collaboration items do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
